newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel weakens with futures, barges tight.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel weakens with futures, barges tight.

text.p: NWE jet fuel eased slightly on Thursday on weaker benchmark IPE futures and lacklustre premiums as cargo buyers remained elusive, traders said.
On the cif cargo market, premiums were talked at Oct IPE +$34/+$35. There was talk that a cargo traded at Oct IPE +$35 cif Copenhagen but this was not confirmed.

On the barge market, premiums were assessed around Oct IPE +$28/+$30, amid very tight supply. "I only know of one person offering barge material at the moment," one trader said. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7714
